question: After 1500 cycles, what capacity does the cathode deliver per gram of sulfur and per gram of the whole electrode, and what sulfur share of the electrode does their ratio imply, against the sulfur content the paper states?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE regexp_matches(text, '1500|mAh|wt|sulfur loading|mg cm|mg/cm|per gram|g−1|g-1|g−1') ORDER BY page, top

SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE page=5 AND line_no BETWEEN 95 AND 115 OR (page=5 AND id IN ('p5.L100','p5.L101','p5.L102','p5.L103','p5.L104','p5.L105','p5.L106','p5.L107','p5.L108','p5.L109','p5.L110')) ORDER BY page, line_no

SELECT 100*CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p5.L105'),'delivers (\d+) mAh/g',1) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p5.L103'),'with (\d+) mAh/',1) AS DOUBLE) AS implied_sulfur_pct, CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p5.L108'),'(\d+) wt %',1) AS DOUBLE) AS stated_sulfur_pct
